name: What are the time savings from AI generative design?

mainEntity.name: What are the time savings from AI generative design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Design cycles can shrink from weeks to hours by automating iterations, allowing architects to focus on refinement rather than initial exploration and modeling. tribe+1
